question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing right winger, Dave is playing left winger, Eve is playing right back, Fred is playing striker, and Gertrude is playing right midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Fred and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Fred and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Finally, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) goalkeeper
(C) right winger
(D) left winger
(E) right back
(F) striker
(G) right midfielder
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: sweeper, goalkeeper, right winger, left winger, right back, striker, right midfielder
1. Fred ↔ Claire: sweeper, goalkeeper, striker, left winger, right back, right winger, right midfielder
2. Eve ↔ Dave: sweeper, goalkeeper, striker, right back, left winger, right winger, right midfielder
3. Bob ↔ Dave: sweeper, right back, striker, goalkeeper, left winger, right winger, right midfielder
4. Fred ↔ Dave: sweeper, right back, striker, right winger, left winger, goalkeeper, right midfielder
5. Gertrude ↔ Eve: sweeper, right back, striker, right winger, right midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger
6. Dave ↔ Alice: right winger, right back, striker, sweeper, right midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: right winger, right back, striker, left winger, right midfielder, goalkeeper, sweeper
Fred is playing goalkeeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
